navaid.name: Half Tide Rocks
navaid.description: This group of rocks is called Half Tide Rocks, and formerly contained one rock called Gangway Rock, but it was removed under a US Army contract in the 1880s (see note:ref). This group of rocks is still called Gangway Rock in some modern maps.
